title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:

Jesse Palmer leads three Christmas Eve challenges as the finalists upgrade Santa's cookies with macaron wreaths, stuff their stockings with éclairs and build showstopping holiday train cakes for the title of Holiday Baking Champion.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:

Jesse Palmer explores holiday traditions by challenging the bakers to craft Kwanzaa plantain desserts, make large edible ornaments and create puff pastry Christmas tree pull-aparts for judges Carla Hall, Duff Goldman and Nancy Fuller to tear into.

description:

description:

title: Carnival Eats
description:

Noah visits the North Florida Fair in Tallahassee for dead heat tacos, the bacon blast and the belly buster Philly cheesesteak; the Erin Fall Fair in Ontario, Canada serves up Ag Ladies apple dumplings, pork belly sliders and crackle lanterns.

title: Tournament of Champions
description:

Fieri welcomes the Great 8 back into the arena to compete in the tough quarterfinals; eight of the world's best chefs go head-to-head in four sudden death battles and deal with the randomizer to earn a trip to the finale.

description:

After a peppermint dessert preheat, Jesse Palmer asks the baking teams to make radical red velvet desserts in honor of Santa's fresh fit; Judges Duff Goldman, Kardea Brown and Molly Yeh choose the winner of the $1,000 prize package.

title: Harry Potter: Wizards of Baking
description:
S03 E02 — The Chamber Challenge
James and Oliver ask the baking teams to bring the Basilisk, Moaning Myrtle, a Howler and Hermione as a cat to life in their cakes; the showpieces are presented to judges Duff Goldman and Sarah Mountain in the iconic Chamber of Secrets itself.

description:

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S25 E11 — Turkey-Giving
In Princeton, N.J., a crêpe restaurant has a new take on a turkey club; in Somersworth, N.H., a turkey meatloaf and a haddock sandwich; in Louisville, Ky., a restaurant practices a pay-what-you-can business model.

description:

Guy Fieri travels the country, digging into awesome bird and beef; in Longmont, a fried chicken emporium serves up their specialty along with unique chicharrones.

description:

A funky joint in Little Rock, Ark., pairs their craft brews with all kinds of on-the-bun creations; two brothers put out real deal Italian food; a sandwich shop in Santa Rosa, Calif., dishes out all kinds of righteous recipes.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S30 E02 — Whole Lotta Comfort
Hearty helpings of comfort include a soul food spot dishing out Southern seafood and killer fried chicken in Atlanta.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:

Guy Fieri is firing up an entire world of barbecue, from chicken salad in Delaware to Argentinian flavor in San Diego and a traditional Hawaiian pig roast down in the ground in Kauai, Hawaii.

description:

A Japanese-Hawaiian spot putting a quick spin on fish, burgers and burritos; a bakery cooking up Down Under comfort food like meat pies and sausage rolls; a funky joint serving international mashups like Pasta Chihuahua and an oxtail tostada.

description:
S33 E08 — Bagels, Biscuit and Boar
Guy Fieri is diggin' into all kinds of flavor, starting in Santa Fe, N.M., at a pub serving comfort grub like chicken and biscuits and in-the-shell clam chowder.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S41 E07 — Tacos, Tots and Chops
Guy Fieri enjoys a fun, filling fiesta, kicking off in Grand Junction, Colo., where a pub serves a real deal Reuben; a spot in Salt Lake City elevates tacos; an outrageous joint in Nashville, Tenn., cooks up Middle Eastern specialties.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S42 E07 — From Italian to Asian
Guy Fieri starts at a Vietnamese spot in Albuquerque, N.M., with banh mi; in Anchorage, Alaska, there's real Italian deli.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:

Loading up the meat with bomb beef and bird; in North Conway, N.H., a funky joint is putting Thai in their tacos, and a local gem in Emerald Isle, N.C., is firin' up big barbecue; in Taos, N.M., a traditional spot serves up New Mexican specialties.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:

Guy Fieri is checking out all kinds of culinary spots, like a Las Vegas food truck smoking up monster sandwiches and a California comfort spot with pot pie; a Mediterranean joint's beef skewers and tandoori chicken.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:

Guy Fieri's diving into a flavor overload; a rockin' food truck in Mobile, AL, is dishing out next-level tacos, while an Indian joint in Alberta, Canada, is serving up street food with flair; in Los Angeles, a vegan oasis puts a spin on Bolognese.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S50 E07 — All Over Flavor
Guy Fieri's getting into flavors from all over, starting with a Vietnamese spot in Boston that's dishing out rocking rice noodle rolls; Guy finds a legit lamb meatball sub and knockout octopus in Montana.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:

Guy Fieri is digging into cheffed-up eats of all kinds; a "Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives" alum is sourcing local Decatur, Ga., ingredients for coffee-dusted venison; a joint in Texas is topping its bagels with basil schmears.

description:

title: Delicious Miss Brown

Kardea gathers friends around the fire pit for a cozy meal; dinner includes beef and okra stew served with sweet potatoes topped with roasted marshmallows; for dessert, caramel apple cake and warm spiced apple cider.

description:
S03 E10 — All About the Sides
Kardea Brown is keeping Thanksgiving intimate with a special meal for Ma and Grandma; Grandma always brings the turkey, so Kardea is taking on the sides, with candied yams, oyster stuffing and cranberry custard pie for dessert.

title: Delicious Miss Brown
description:
S04 E10 — There's Nothing Like Home Cooking
Kardea Brown treats her friend to some Southern home cooking; the meal includes lemon and garlic baked chicken, country wild rice with sausage and collard greens with tomatoes; for dessert, Kardea makes upside down peach cornbread cake.

title: Delicious Miss Brown
description:
S05 E10 — Friendsgiving
Kardea Brown invites her best friends over for Friendsgiving, and she's in charge of the turkey and side dishes; deviled crabs in the shell, a Cajun butter spatchcock turkey, fried cabbage and sweet potato stuffed cornbread.

description:

Thanksgiving turkey gets cooked and portioned out in advance; doctored-up dressing and gussied-up gravy; roasted sprouts and onions; spiked cranberry sauce and herby butter dinner rolls; chocolate marshmallow pumpkin pie.

description:
S36 E09 — Thanksgiving Sides Central
Ree Drummond puts a spin on everyone's favorite Thanksgiving sides; she makes over colorful spicy maple roasted carrots, macaroni-inspired baked cheesy O's, a shortcut cheesy brown butter focaccia and classic broccoli casserole.

description:
S29 E11 — Fabulous Friendsgiving
The Kitchen hosts throw a Friendsgiving party that kicks off with toasted mulled cider margaritas, and baked brie with cranberry chutney and toasted almonds; roasted turkey and root vegetables and mini pumpkin spice latte puddings for dessert.

description:

The Kitchen goes big on Thanksgiving flavors with mashup favorites! Katie Lee Biegel makes Spinach Artichoke Dip Stuffed Mushrooms, Jeff Mauro preps Jalapeños and Cranberry Stuffed Turkey Breast and Sunny Anderson bakes Adult Pecan Pie Brownie Bars.

description:

description:

Jeff Mauro and the Holiday Wars time machine send the remaining four teams back in time; each group must create a Santa from a specific period in history; judges Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira decide who will move forward.

title: Holiday Wars
description:

Jeff Mauro invites the remaining teams to create a Christmas tree featuring Charles Schulz's beloved Peanuts characters; two teams will face off in the finale for a trip to Iceland.

Throwing it back to iconic party bites that deserve a comeback with new twists; fon-duo of taleggio fondue and quick horchata fondue, mini beef wellington bites, and retro rum ginger pomegranate punch.

The recruits are tasked with creating an after-party event that's high on flavor and flair; then, chefs Jeff Mauro and Tiffany Derry challenge their teams to craft brunch burgers with fries and a Bloody Mary.

Ladd and his father look forward to a slap-up cowboy spread; Ree makes a PW steak rub to sprinkle over breakfast steaks; side dish: breakfast grits with bacon and jalapeños; a pan of Ree's mom's classic apple dumplings.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S22 E07 — No Cooking Required
Ree plays around with fuss-free food with no cooking required; she makes a ranch muffuletta sandwich; a rotisserie chicken is the secret to her Chinese chicken salad with ginger and chili dressing; she finishes with magical Mermaid Ice Cream.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S34 E02 — One Becomes Three
Ree Drummond shares how one paprika pork shoulder becomes three budget-friendly meals; she makes white beans with pork and croutons for lunch followed by sheet pan nachos and pork celebration sandwiches for the cowboys.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S40 E16 — Count on Chicken
Ree Drummond is cooking chicken dishes for busy times, including Marry Me Chicken with Brown Butter Mashed Potatoes, quick Chicken Avocado Pizza and crispy Chicken Nuggets.

title: The Kitchen
description:

The Kitchen hosts a star-studded Thanksgiving with Nancy Fuller and Valerie Bertinelli, complete with a lemon and herb roasted turkey, a root vegetable one-dish side and mac and cheese; the kitchen helpline is open for Turkey Day questions.

"The Kitchen" crew puts tailgate foods on a stick; Jeff Mauro flips the script on a classic sandwich with his Philly cheese sticks; Geoffrey Zakarian pours out a real beer float; Sunny Anderson brings sweet heat with buffalo chicken meatballs.
